TIMELESS_DAPI.limitation: Conditional numerical reproduction only. Biological replicate IDs are absent; these tests do not establish replicate-level inference.

MTT.limitation: Pooled normalized wells, mean +/- SEM: 6 wells/genotype at 5/10 mM, 9 at 0/20/40 mM. Each well is treated as a biological replicate at the authors' direction; culture-preparation IDs remain available. No inferential tests. July 15 source control is labelled DMSO.

locomotion.note: Exact permutation enumerates all 70 allocations and handles ties explicitly; inference assumes independent populations.

stress.limitation: Enrichment relative to other curated genes; nonsignificance does not show absence of pathway activation. ER-UPR sets are not a dedicated mitochondrial UPR assay.
